title_zh: 青城 · 呼和浩特的前世今生
title_en: The Blue City · Hohhot Through the Ages

lines: 阴山以南，黄河以北，
South of the Yinshan Mountains, north of the Yellow River,
坐落着一座“青色的城”。
stands a city known as "the Blue City".
蒙古语里，它叫呼和浩特。
In Mongolian, its name is Hohhot.
早在几十万年前，
Hundreds of thousands of years ago,
远古人类就在大窑一带打制石器。
early humans were already making stone tools at Dayao.
战国时，赵武灵王在此设云中郡，
In the Warring States era, King Wuling of Zhao founded Yunzhong Commandery here,
农耕与游牧，从此在这里交汇。
and here farming and nomadic life began to meet.
西汉，王昭君远嫁匈奴，
In the Western Han, Wang Zhaojun married into the Xiongnu,
换来汉匈之间数十年的和平。
bringing decades of peace between the Han and the Xiongnu.
她的青冢，至今静立在城南。
Her tomb, the Green Mound, still stands south of the city.
北魏的先祖，曾以盛乐为都；
The forebears of the Northern Wei once made Shengle their capital;
辽代，丰州城里建起一座白塔，
under the Liao, a White Pagoda rose in the city of Fengzhou,
千年风雨，它依然挺立。
and after a thousand years, it still stands.
1572年，阿勒坦汗在此筑城，
In 1572, Altan Khan began building a city here,
明朝赐名“归化”。
and the Ming court named it Guihua.
大召寺随之兴建，城因寺兴，
With Dazhao Temple built, the city grew around its monasteries,
人们称它“召城”。
and people called it "the City of Temples".
清代，又在东北筑起绥远城，
In the Qing, the city of Suiyuan was built to the northeast;
两城合称“归绥”。
together, the two were called Guisui.
驼队从这里出发，穿越大漠，
Camel caravans set out from here across the desert,
把茶叶与丝绸运向远方。
carrying tea and silk to distant lands.
1954年，归绥更名为呼和浩特，
In 1954, Guisui was renamed Hohhot,
成为内蒙古自治区首府。
becoming the capital of the Inner Mongolia Autonomous Region.
今天，这里是“中国乳都”，
Today it is known as China's "Dairy Capital",
也是北方重要的云计算基地。
and a major cloud-computing hub in the north.
青城依旧。
The Blue City endures.
草原的风，从千年前吹到今天。
The grassland wind still blows, from a thousand years ago to today.
